priorityList: Use offensive Trinkets, Racials, and Potions when Takedown is ready or its buff is active.
Use Aspect of the Eagle if you are outside of melee range of your target.
Cast Kill Command if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear and any Pack Leader buff (Wyvern, Boar, or Bear) is active.
Cast Kill Command if Takedown is about to come off cooldown and you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Takedown if Tip of the Spear is active, or at 0 stacks if you have the Twin Fangs talent.
Cast Boomstick if Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if Tip of the Spear is active and it will extend Fury of the Wyvern.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if Tip of the Spear is active or to refresh the Raptor Swipe damage buff.
Cast Kill Command while Takedown is on cooldown to generate resources and stacks.
Cast Wildfire Bomb whenever a charge is available.
Cast Takedown as a filler if available.
